title: Who Owns the Leads Your Agency Generates? Check the Permissions Table, Not the Contract.
meta_description: Your lead generation contract says the leads are yours. Google Ads deletes lead form leads after 60 days and blocks manager accounts from downloading them without granted ownership, and Meta says leads belong to the Page. What to fix before the next campaign runs.
